newsitem.title: USA: New World Coffee sees strong Q3.
newsitem.headline: New World Coffee sees strong Q3.

text.p: New World Coffee Inc said Tuesday that it forecasts a strong performance in the third quarter.

The company said it expects to grow store level sales through the fresh-baked bagel program now being implemented in its stores, and to see revenues from its new franchising program starting in the third quarter.

The company said it expects continued improvement in store operating margins due to a lower cost of goods and reduced waste from in-store baking and food preparation, and lower occupancy costs as a percentage of sales from store sales growth, both resulting from its bagel conversion program.

The company also said it expects its general and administrative expenses to continue to decline as a percentage of sales as it receives the full benefit of its mid-second quarter corporate overhead reduction and anticipated revenue growth that will leverage its management infrastructure.
